label: the accessor ignores the stored name and re-derives it from the site id, so a site with its own Worker name deploys, routes and deletes against a Worker that does not exist
the workers-target cascade deletes the site id instead of the Worker name, which 404s (success here) and leaves the Worker serving
the publish path stops handing the deployer the row's Worker name, so a re-publish deploys a second Worker under the derived name
the D1 binding takes the Worker's name, so a renamed Worker binds a database that was never created
the provision job stops handing provision_deploy the row's Worker name, so a dynamic site deploys under the derived name
